info.title: Hamzet Wasl API
info.description:
Phase 1 backend contract for Hamzet Wasl (همزة وصل).

**Sign Up Flow (No Token Required):**
1. `POST /api/v1/auth/register` — validates data & sends phone OTP (does NOT save account to DB yet; returns `registrationTicket`).
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/register/complete` — verifies OTP with `registrationTicket`, creates the account, and returns `accessToken` + `refreshToken`.
3. Click **Authorize** above and paste `accessToken` to call protected profile/verification/organization endpoints.

*Note: `/auth/email/*` and `/auth/phone/*` require a Bearer token and are for already logged-in users (e.g. Volunteer identity verification).*
